description: Fetch a user by login/username. Provider-shaped, with provider-form ids.

login.description: The user's login (GitHub) or username (GitLab), e.g. 'athena'.

provider.description: The git host to read the user from, one of the ids orient lists: 'github', 'gitlab', 'bitbucket' or 'ado', e.g. 'github'.

name: get_user
title: Get a user
